callouts.id: 满足特定条件的两个集合尺寸的比例#1
callouts.title: APMO 2013,P4
callouts.body: $A,B$是整数集的两个不相交的有限子集，$a,b$是两个正整数，此外$$A\cup B \subset (A-a)\cup (B+b)$$其中$A-a:=\{x-a:x \in A\},B+b:=\{x+b:x \in B\}$证明$$a|A|=b|B|$$

classification_result.id: 满足特定条件的两个集合尺寸的比例#1

if_problem.statement_en: Let $A,B$ be two disjoint finite subsets of the integers, and let $a,b$ be two positive integers. Suppose moreover that $$A\cup B \subset (A-a)\cup (B+b)$$ where $A-a:=\{x-a:x \in A\}$ and $B+b:=\{x+b:x \in B\}$. Prove that $$a|A|=b|B|.$$

callouts.id: 满足特定条件的两个集合尺寸的比例#2
callouts.title: 大致的想法
callouts.body: 把集合满足的性质转换为特征函数满足的性质，然后通过处理函数的手段研究特征函数，最后把分析的结果对应到集合的性质上去。

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Translate Set Conditions into Indicator Functions
if_strategy_template.summary_en: Convert the property satisfied by the sets into a property of their indicator functions, then study those functions using analytic methods. Finally, translate the analytic conclusion back into a structural statement about the sets.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when a problem about sets can be encoded by indicator functions, especially when shifts, convolutions, or Fourier-analytic tools are useful.

callouts.title: 定义整数加法群上的傅里叶变换
callouts.body: 根据[[Riemann - Lebesgue lemma的证明]]当中3的讨论，注意到$\mathbb{Z}$的庞特里亚金对偶群是$\widehat{\mathbb{Z}}:=\{e^{2\pi i n \xi}:\xi \in [0,1)]\}$,于是这种意义下的$f \in L^1(\mathbb{Z})$的函数其傅里叶变换定义为$$\widehat{f}(\xi ):=\sum_{n\in \mathbb{Z}}f(n)e^{-2\pi i n \xi}$$其傅里叶逆变换(如果成立的话)为$$f(n)=\int_{0}^{1}\widehat{f}(\xi)e^{2\pi i n \xi}\,d\xi$$
